:::{#exm-local-maximizer}
#### A local maximizer

Let $f(x) = 1 - x^2$.
For every $x \in \reals$,

$$
\ba
f(0) - f(x)
&= 1 - (1 - x^2)
&& \text{(substitute)}
\\
&= x^2
&& \text{(simplify)}
\\
&\ge 0,
&& \text{(a square)}
\ea
$$

so $f(0) \ge f(x)$ for all $x$, and $0$ is a local maximizer of $f$ with any $\tolin > 0$.

:::
